_about: Bounded exceptions to the rewriters' object proof (coordinator ruling 2026-10-11). An entry lets ONE object differ when (a) the batch edits at least one of its headers and (b) tools/objhash.py classify_allowed confirms the class per symbol. No blanket ignores; every accepted object is named in the commit message. --no-proof-allow disables the ledger.

entries.reason: The TU holds unreferenced static const tables in its non-COMDAT .rdata (stbi__z* / stbi__depth_scale_table, k_biomeFoliage); adding an inline variable to one of these headers makes MSVC lay them out in another order (or drop them). Verified per symbol: every other section, the rest of the symbol set and every .data / .bss symbol identical, every static present in both identical, any static present in only one never a relocation target. Found by editor/MapGeneratorDialog bisect 2026-10-11 (12 headers individually).
